recommendation: Keep the published source fix. It resolves the stale core guidance and aligns the current build with FHIR-15879, FHIR-32897, and FHIR-40915 without requiring additional core follow-up.
issue_request: FHIR-15879 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked how canonical references should carry a human-readable name for rendering when the URL alone is not appropriate, and the final decision was to define a common extension plus add Canonical URLs rendering guidance explaining lookup, stale narrative, and why canonical uses an extension while Reference has Reference.display.
initial_application: The Jira application comment cites svn revision 13877, represented by git commit 48f836df16eaf44ee379e6160e479843703fc01f. That commit added the Rendering References in Resource Narratives section and discussed reference resolution and stale narrative, but it pointed canonical display needs to the Rendered Value extension.
additional_context: Current source already documents the display extension on the canonical primitive row through the FHIR-32897 reconciliation. FHIR-40915 later concluded rendered-value should not include canonical because canonical display already exists, and Extension Pack commit c72b0548f8b06e830675ec35d7fc101ded26e65a removed canonical from rendered-value while display remains scoped to canonical.
reconciliation: Updated source/references.html to point canonical display needs to the display extension, explain that canonical remains a primitive URL-valued type rather than a complex reference, and align the extension's purpose with Reference.display. No Extension Pack source was changed because the current external definitions already reflect the later decision.
